exposure: knowledge of successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Pregnant mothers with one previous cesarean section at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (UoGCSH) in Ethiopia
finding: The majority (71.5%) of pregnant mothers with one previous cesarean section preferred trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
mod_finding: Mothers who were married, had a diploma educational level, had previous post-cesarean complications, and knew about the success of TOLAC were more likely to prefer TOLAC.
